title: Flights per airline
statementMd:
Number of flights per airline code.

Expected columns: `airline_code`, `flights`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT airline_code, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM flights GROUP BY airline_code;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
